Dear [Mrs Dampier](../persons.html#1345)
All good thanks and wishes.

Happy you.

Poor [Mrs Jones Bateman](../persons.html#784).

Lloyd is rejoicing to go.

She is gone from home unable to stay alone

Yours affectionately

C M Yonge

[^1]: The letter presumably dates from after the arrival of the Jones-Batemans in Otterbourne in the 1870s.
